description:
Review finding from worktree-qzr2-wal-trim.

Problem:
When recovery stalls, do_recovery stores the returned stalled attempt only in config.recovery_attempt. It leaves Director state.recovery_attempt unchanged. The next service-registration retry calls setup_for_subsequent_recovery against that older in-memory attempt, losing phase mutations such as lock_failed_service_ids, recruited services, and other accumulated observations.

Impact:
The qzr.14 promise that failed locks are remembered across attempts does not hold for normal in-process retries. Recovery can repeatedly select ghosts, redo recruitment, and accumulate stray workers.

Acceptance criteria:
- The live Director state adopts the stalled RecoveryAttempt before returning.
- The persisted config and live recovery_attempt reference the same logical attempt state.
- Subsequent retries increment the retained attempt while preserving lock_failed_service_ids and other intended cross-attempt fields.
- Tests drive do_recovery through a mutating phase followed by a stall, trigger an in-process retry, and prove the mutations remain.
- Restart-from-persisted-config behavior remains covered.
title: Retain stalled RecoveryAttempt state for subsequent in-process retries
